name: D-3P-O2
description: D-3P-O2 was a specially-programmed 3PO-series protocol droid responsible for managing Managing Director Vost Tyne's schedule while he was assigned to the hyperbaride plant on Marca. It had a thick accent as it had been programmed by Imperials from the Core Worlds.
